title: Payment for order flow and market makers - Research by BrokerChooser
text:
----------------------------------------
I bring over two decades of specialized financial market reporting experience to my role at BrokerChooser, including extended tenures as a correspondent for Bloomberg, Dow Jones Newswires, and The Wall Street Journal. My coverage areas have encompassed macroeconomics, equity markets, currency trading, and fixed-income securities, providing me with comprehensive insight across major investment categories. I hold a Master's degree in American Studies and Journalism from ELTE University.
